BRING YOUR MUSIC

A song becomes a lesson.

Drop in the notes, then learn them at your own pace.

MIDI · exact notes & timing

The best choice for any arrangement. Includes chords and multiple tracks.

Audio · experimental melody detection

For a clean, single instrument or hummed melody. Mixed songs, chords and drums will produce errors. First 60 seconds; review the result before practicing.

 A QUICK TOUR

Make yourself at home.

01
Play something

Click the keys, use A–L and the upper black-key row, or connect a USB MIDI keyboard. Switch instruments to find a sound you like. Guitar uses recorded steel-string samples; the other instruments use synthesis.

02
Build a little loop

Open Sequence. Add notes to the grid across three tracks, or press record and play. Notes snap to eighth notes in a two-bar loop. Adjust tempo, mute tracks, undo edits, and export a MIDI file.

03
Learn at your own pace

Choose a built-in melody or import MIDI. Notes fall toward their keys. “Wait for me” pauses until you press the right notes. “Listen” plays the piece for you. Adjust speed or loop to practice again.

MIDI hardware support depends on your browser and permissions. Chrome or Edge on desktop is recommended. Your sequence is stored locally in this browser.
